text:
Nora: Curious thought for the morning: if you could swap your morning routine with any fictional character, who would it be and why? :coffee:
Devon: Sherlock Holmes. Early walks, sharp mind, and someone else to do my laundry. :mag_right:
Ivy: Luna Lovegood 10% for the rad scarves, 90% for peaceful breakfast vibes and pastel cereals.
Raj: The Mandalorian. Quiet, efficient, and a travel-sized helmet I can nap in. Also, "This is the way" to schedule naps.
Nora: Haha love it. Devon 10% detective, 90% laundry hero. Ivy 10% scarf energy.
Devon: Also he'd probably analyze my emails before I open them. Dangerous.
Ivy: Also I want to float into meetings like I'm slightly distracted by invisible creatures. :hatching_chick:
Raj: Bonus point if the character makes a legendary cup of coffee. Whoever suggested Frodo can beat rush hour on foot gets my vote.
Nora: Frodo would also bring snacks and unexpected bravery. Samwise would actually carry extra chargers.
Devon: Can we have a mandate: every office kitchen must have at least one Samwise-level charger hoard.
Ivy: @calendar-bot add recurring event: "Samwise Charger Stockpile" every Monday at 10am.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Samwise Charger Stockpile" (Weekly, Mondays 10:00). :spiral_calendar:
Raj: Official petition to replace one "standup" with a 5-min fictional morning ritual swap. Vote with emoji.
Nora: This thread proves we need more character-crossovers in real life. Thanks folks, consider my morning ritual officially up for negotiation. :grin:
